name: "Why do I have an empath 5???"
author: erik
bootlegger: The hermit thinks they are a minion (or legion). A minion that has the character the hermit sees knows about the hermit and their choices. If the hermit thinks they are the evil twin, then a minion is the "good twin" and learns this. If a hermit evil twin and evil twin both are in play then they become a real evil twin pair but the hermit thinks the evil twin is a good character. A hermit scarlet woman may learn that they have become the demon, a hermit widow learns the wrong grimoar, etc.
Minions and demons wake seperately for minion and demon info.

Minions seperately wake to place a vote on who they want to hold the baby: if there is a tie then the storyteller either lets them choose again or decides for them. Minions and demons learn who the hermit thinks is holding the baby.
If legion is in play: the faux paw registers as good when voting for executions.
